name: lead-gen-sys
description: Sovereign, self-hosted, vertical-agnostic lead distribution CRM with Ping & Post auctions.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm --workspace api run migrate && npm --workspace api run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --workspace api run dev" "npm --workspace web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace api run build && npm --workspace web run build
